data.body: Fixes bug B226d8db6e8: api.brief with no --item took plan.ready[0] and rendered it as 'Current', even when the agent held a live lease on another item. Now: no --item -> the agent's own live leases; one -> it is Current; several -> Current is the most recently claimed and the rest are listed; none -> ready[0] rendered as 'Suggested next'. Same for MCP ddflow_brief (as_agent flows through api.brief). Fixes bug B7a5c63e3d2: api.complete with no --model passed '' to reviewer_independence; now defaults to the model of the agent's most recent open session (session start --model), on both surfaces since both call api.complete; when still unknown the refusal says to pass --model <author model> instead of quoting ''. MCP clientInfo carries the harness name, not a model, so it is not a source.
data.title: A command under an --agent identity uses what that agent holds: brief's Current is the agent's own lease (else 'Suggested next'), complete defaults the author model from the agent's open session (fixes bugs B226d8db6e8, B7a5c63e3d2)

data.claim: api.brief falls back to plan.ready[0] whenever --item is absent, ignoring the agent's own live lease, and renders it as Current
data.falsifier: brief under the claiming agent headed with the claimed item
data.probe: fresh repo: task add C11, T2; --agent impl claim T2; --agent impl brief | grep Current
data.question: Does 'ddflow --agent X brief' show an item X never claimed as Current?

data.claim: api.complete passes model='' to reviewer_independence when --model is absent; nothing reads the agent's session.started model
data.falsifier: complete without --model after session start --model claude-opus reports independence by family
data.probe: fresh repo: --agent impl session start --model claude-opus; claim T2; gate record rubber_duck --model gpt-5; --agent impl complete T2
data.probe_output: reviewer independence not satisfied: the author's model '' is not in [agent].families
data.question: Does complete ignore the author model the agent declared at session start?
sources: ddflow/surfaces/mcp.py initialize (clientInfo is a harness label

evidence.note: R3e97ac836f CONFIRMED: fresh repo, --agent impl claim T2; --agent impl brief -> '## Current: C11'. R7d1bdbc6de CONFIRMED: session start --model claude-opus; --agent impl complete T2 -> "author's model '' is not in [agent].families".

ddflow brief --item B-fix-agent-defaults (exit 0): only globless decisions (quotas, co-author trailer) — none govern brief/complete; recall surfaced L-delegated-leases-heartbeat and La096a4fab1 (identity per call), both consistent with deriving defaults from the --agent identity's own records

commit 7808c83: api.brief picks the agent's live leases (most recent first) before plan.ready[0]; several -> 'You hold N leases' list; none -> ready[0] rendered '## Suggested next' (+ held/suggested in the outcome data). api.complete defaults model from the agent's most recent open session (_session_model, identity-scoped); reviewer_independence with an empty author model says 'pass --model <author model>'. Regression tests: tests/test_agent_defaults.py, 7/9 fail on unfixed code, 9/9 pass after.

titles: ddflow/api/lifecycle.py:~1485 (brief `held` filter; same root cause at ~line 985 in `complete`)

evidence.note: env -u PYTHONPATH uv run --with pytest-xdist pytest -q -n 48 in the worktree at ca98d3f: 2864 passed, 1 skipped (exit 0); tests/test_agent_defaults.py 9 passed (7 of them failed on unfixed main)

Hunted: (1) identity mismatch cfg.agent.id vs log.agent_id (raised by reviewer) - probe: _load(repo,'alice'), derived, and DDFLOW_AGENT=envbob all give cfg.agent.id == log.agent_id (True x3), since _load builds EventLog(repo, resolved); (2) recency vs id order - test now claims T3 then T2 and asserts Current T2; (3) expired/removed leases - excluded via st.active_leases(now, grace) and .removed; (4) another agent's session model - test_complete_does_not_borrow_another_agents_session_model; (5) explicit --model still wins - test_complete_explicit_model_wins_over_the_session; (6) SessionStart hook brief (api.setup) for a parent holding nothing now says 'Suggested next' - intended. No new defect.

grep for an existing 'leases held by me' / 'session model of agent' helper: none (lease holder filters are inline at lifecycle.py:164/186/208/380, jobs.py:51, gates.py:221); session model was read nowhere before. One new private helper _session_model, no copy.

ruff check . (All checks passed) + ruff format --check . (310 files already formatted) at ca98d3f, exit 0. roborev review 7808c83 job 882 (kilo): 'No issues found' (finished after the 600s --wait cap; result read with roborev show 882). ca98d3f after it is a test-only reordering of claims.

titles: ddflow/api/lifecycle.py:1485 (`brief`, the `held` comprehension) and ddflow/api/lifecycle.py:983 (`complete`, `_session_model` call)

evidence.note: Cross-family review (deepseek, via ddflow review) raised one finding, twice per gate: the new lease filter and _session_model key on log.agent_id while plan() uses cfg.agent.id or log.agent_id, so under --agent alice with an ambient id the agent's lease/session would be missed. OVERRULED, refuted by probe: api._base._load resolves the identity once and builds EventLog(repo, resolved) after writing it back to cfg.agent.id, so they are equal: _load(repo,'alice') -> alice/alice True; derived -> Monster3-repro-agent-7c01fb twice True; DDFLOW_AGENT=envbob -> envbob/envbob True. The exact alleged scenario (CLI --agent impl while the ambient derived id differs; MCP as_agent=impl on a Server whose own identity differs) is what tests/test_agent_defaults.py runs and passes (9 passed at ca98d3f); held/session lookups also match the codebase convention (lease.holder == log.agent_id in jobs.py:51, gates.py:221). An earlier critic LOW finding (several-leases test could not tell recency from id order) was ACCEPTED and fixed in ca98d3f.
